title.zh: 量子计算机到底能做什么
title.en: What Quantum Computers Can Actually Do

desc.zh: 量子计算机到底能做什么普通计算机做不了的事？页面里有一台真的量子态模拟器：从一个量子比特、干涉、纠缠，到格罗弗搜索、肖尔分解、噪声和纠错，最后是标了日期和出处的 2026 年前沿。
desc.en: What can a quantum computer do that an ordinary computer cannot? The page includes a real quantum-state simulator: from one qubit, interference and entanglement, through Grover's search, Shor's factoring, noise and error correction, to the 2026 frontier with every date and source marked.
